cohort: A 33-year-old female referred with an initial diagnosis of ectopic pregnancy.
finding: Transabdominal ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) demonstrated a nodular mass on a caesarean section scar, which was finally histopathologically diagnosed as CSS choriocarcinoma.
mod_finding: Primary gestational choriocarcinoma was found in a uterine caesarean section scar.
